title: Statistics
description: Corpus health, learner activity and content quality.
corpusError: The corpus could not be loaded.

common.unavailableHelp: This block could not be loaded. The other figures on the page are still valid.

demo.title: Demo data
demo.body: {{demo}} of {{total}} rows come from the demo dataset, not from real learners. Do not base decisions on these figures.

corpus.emptyBody: Statistics appear as soon as the corpus has lessons.
corpus.coverageSub: Share of lessons that meet each criterion.
corpus.coverageInfo: Green from 80%, orange from 50 to 79%, red below 50%.

cov.contentInfo: The lesson has at least one content block.
cov.quizInfo: The lesson has a quiz with a question and filled-in answers.
cov.translatedInfo: A lesson counts as translated when at least one block is translated. A translated title alone is not enough.

corpus.byDomainInfo: Each bar stacks the domain's published lessons, drafts and lessons that are still empty.
corpus.gapsSub: The first lessons concerned, with a link to the full list.
corpus.noGaps: No gaps: every lesson has content, a quiz and a module.

learners.notInstalledTitle: Learner tracking is not enabled yet
learners.notInstalledBody: Learner figures will appear here once tracking is installed on the database. Ask your technical contact to enable learner statistics.
learners.topInfo: How many times each lesson was completed, across all learners.
learners.hardestInfo: Share of correct quiz answers. The shorter the bar, the more learners struggle. Only lessons completed at least 3 times are counted.
learners.noHardest: Not enough quizzes answered yet (3 per lesson minimum).
learners.timeInfo: Average time spent in the lesson by learners who opened it.
learners.eventsNotInstalled: Detailed lesson tracking is not enabled yet.
learners.missionsInfo: Number of mission rewards claimed by learners.
learners.missionsMissing: Mission tracking is not enabled yet.
learners.retentionInfo: Share of learners who come back 7 days (D+7) or 30 days (D+30) after their first lesson.
learners.retentionProxy: Not enough history yet to measure real 7- and 30-day returns. D+7 is estimated from the share of learners on a streak.
learners.masteryHint: share of quizzes passed with no mistake
learners.funnelInfo: How many learners reach each step of a lesson. The red bar is the step where most learners leave.
learners.funnelEmpty: No step data for this lesson yet.
learners.funnelWorst: Biggest drop at {{step}}: {{pct}} of learners stop.
learners.funnelProxy: Step-by-step tracking is not available yet. Instead: the lessons whose quiz fails most, where learners probably drop off.
learners.corrInfo: Each dot is a trading-simulator session: left means few quizzes passed, right many; up is a gain, down a loss. If dots rise to the right, quizzes help learners trade better.
learners.corrProxyMissing: Simulator results are not tracked yet. Instead: quiz success compared with lessons completed.
learners.corrProxyEmpty: No simulator session recorded. Instead: quiz success compared with lessons completed.
learners.corrLegend: Green: winning session. Red: losing session.

quality.readabilitySub: Breakdown of the lessons shown in the table.
quality.readabilityInfo: Score from 0 to 100 computed for French (Kandel and Moles formula) from sentence and word length. 60 and above: easy; 40 to 59: medium; below 40: hard. No score under 30 words.
quality.bloomInfo: Highest level of demand found in the text, from verbs such as “explain”, “calculate” or “compare” (whole words). A hint, not a pedagogical assessment.
quality.translatedInfo: A lesson is translated when at least one block is translated. A translated title alone does not count.
quality.csvError: The CSV file could not be created. Try again.
quality.noMatchHelp: Change the search or pick another domain.
quality.caption: Lesson quality, sortable by column
